items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a gentle way to start a routine aimed at the look of fine lines.
Your scan shows low moisture, and a ceramide moisturizer helps keep skin comfortable while it adjusts to retinol.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 protects it during the day.

response.routine_note: Apply the retinol at night to dry skin, 2 nights a week at first, then add nights slowly as your skin stays comfortable, and follow with the moisturizer. Use sunscreen every morning and skip exfoliating acids and scrubs while you settle in.
